description: Get detailed status, configuration, and live performance for a specific trading bot by ID. Returns its run status, the strategy/symbol/exchange it trades, whether it is paper or live, P&L, win rate, total trades, and risk config (leverage, stop-loss, take-profit). Use it to check how a deployed bot is doing. Read-only — to stop a bot use stop_bot. Get bot IDs from list_bots.

id.description: The bot ID to inspect, obtained from list_bots.

name: get_bot_status
